scenes.text: How much hotter is Thailand getting?
In 2024, the national mean was twenty-eight point five degrees, more than a degree above the 1991 to 2020 average.
In April 2023, Tak reached forty-five point four: a national record.
In 2026, Bangkok opened three hundred and four cooling centres, with a strategy for financing its response to heat.
Cool rooms close to home, open when they’re needed.
